headline: Bitcoin slipped back below $60,000 on Friday even as US stocks rallied after Thanksgiving, putting its hoped-for end to a seven-week losing streak in doubt, as US bitcoin funds close out their worst month on record.

market.asOf: Bitcoin read from Decrypt's article published about 19:46 UTC Fri 27 Nov (02:46 Bangkok Sat): $59,576, down 1.58% on the daily chart. Ether and Solana snapshots could not be confirmed this run. Use the live prices on this page.

stories.title: Bitcoin's Friday bounce fails and it drops back below $60,000
stories.summary: Bitcoin climbed above $62,000 early on Friday, then fell to under $59,000 after US stock trading opened, even though stocks rose. Earlier on Friday it had been up for the week, on course to end a seven-week losing streak; it is now below where the week started.
points: Bitcoin was at $59,576, down 1.58% on the day, after an intraday high of $62,210, and is more than 52% below its all-time high, per Decrypt (about 19:46 UTC).
The low was $58,792; the week opened at $61,271, so bitcoin is now below its weekly open, per crypto.news.
About $228 million of crypto bets were liquidated (forcibly closed) in the hour to 15:00 UTC, while the S&P 500 opened 0.9% higher and the Nasdaq 1.4% higher, per Cointelegraph.
About $6.8 billion of bitcoin options expired on Deribit on Friday, per Decrypt.
Bitcoin is down about 20% in November, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: Cointelegraph: bitcoin below $59K as tech stocks rebound
Decrypt: $7 billion of bitcoin options just expired

stories.title: US bitcoin funds set a record for monthly withdrawals, and Strategy leaves MSCI's indexes on Monday
stories.summary: Money pulled from US spot bitcoin funds in November is already a record. On Monday at the close, MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR), the biggest company holder of bitcoin, from its indexes, and funds that track those indexes are expected to sell some of its shares.
points: November outflows reached $5.39 billion per Farside data, above the previous record of $4.51 billion set in June, per CoinReporter.
On Wed 25 Nov the funds lost $453 million, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $329.7 million, per CoinReporter. US markets were shut on Thanksgiving, so there was no flow data for Thursday.
Strategy holds 851,305 bitcoin at an average cost of $75,446, well above today's price, per FinanceFeeds.

Sources differ on the expected selling from the MSCI exit: Cointelegraph credits JPMorgan with an estimate of about $2.8 billion; FinanceFeeds says Strategy itself estimated about $2.8 billion of its stock could be sold.
MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million Strategy shares, about 3.1% of its shares, per Cointelegraph.

sources.label: CoinReporter: bitcoin ETF outflows hit a record $5.39 billion
FinanceFeeds: MSCI to remove Strategy on 30 Nov

stories.title: Binance's withdrawals are back to normal, but funds from the hack are still moving
stories.summary: Binance says the withdrawal freeze from its 29 October hack is fully lifted, with a few networks still paused for maintenance. On Friday a wallet tied to the hack moved about $19.7 million of ether.
points: Binance said the withdrawal suspension from the October security incident has been fully lifted; a small number of networks remain paused for maintenance, per Decrypt via Yahoo Finance.
Binance set aside $6.34 billion to cover losses and won a $6.5 billion freezing order in Abu Dhabi, per Decrypt via Yahoo Finance.
The US Justice Department filed to seize more than $1.1 billion in USDC, and the FBI blames North Korea's TraderTraitor group, per Decrypt via Yahoo Finance.
On Friday 11,989 ETH (about $19.7 million) moved from a wallet tied to the hack, per TokenPost.

sources.label: Decrypt via Yahoo Finance: Binance fully lifts withdrawal suspension

briefs.title: Less new stablecoin money is coming into crypto
briefs.summary: USDT supply on Ethereum and Tron fell $8.1 billion (4.4%) in the 60 days to 23 Nov, the biggest such drop since August 2022, to $174.5 billion, per CryptoQuant via The Block.

briefs.title: Tether raises its stake in bitcoin miner Bitdeer
briefs.summary: Tether bought about 3.72 million Bitdeer shares for about $10 million and now owns 17.9%; Bitdeer's stock is down 74.3% this year, per The Block.

briefs.title: CZ calls $60,000 bitcoin an "attractive price"
briefs.summary: Binance founder Changpeng Zhao said he hopes pessimism has peaked, speaking at BNB Chain Demo Night, per Bloomingbit.

briefs.title: KuCoin delists Monero on Monday
briefs.summary: KuCoin will remove XMR spot trading pairs at 08:00 UTC on 30 Nov; withdrawals stay open until 31 Dec, per KuCoin.

briefs.title: New York wins a $1.37 billion judgment over NovaTech
briefs.summary: New York's Attorney General won the ruling against NovaTech's founders; the firm raised about $650 million from more than 200,000 investors, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody reports a data breach
briefs.summary: Client and employee contact details were exposed; Zodia says there were no unauthorized transactions, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Spain lets its financial watchdog freeze crypto accounts
briefs.summary: A new decree lets Spain's financial intelligence unit freeze crypto accounts for up to 5 business days without a court order, from 25 Jan 2027, per Cointelegraph.

calendar.event: Binance Blockchain Week, Bangkok; Fed quiet period begins
calendar.note: At the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, per Khaosod English. The Fed's pre-meeting blackout runs from Sat 28 Nov to Thu 10 Dec, per the Federal Reserve.

calendar.note: PROS and GRASS on Saturday 28; FF and CARDS on Sunday 29; GRVT, KMNO and GUN on Monday 30 (one tracker gives GUN on the 29th); EIGEN and SUI on Tuesday 1 Dec; M, BTW, ENA, 2Z and Q on Wednesday 2 Dec (M's date is disputed: Tokenomist shows 12 Dec); STO on Thursday 3 Dec; MMT and LA on Friday 4 Dec. See the unlock table on this page for sizes and confidence. (Dates from this desk's unlock data.)
XMR/USDT, USDC, ETH and BTC spot pairs are removed at 08:00 UTC; withdrawals close 31 Dec, per KuCoin.
October was 55.3, per Newsquawk. Release time per MNI.

calendar.event: Trump Media (DJT) noteholders can demand repayment
calendar.note: About $883.5 million of convertible notes are outstanding; the company holds about 15,649 bitcoin, of which 4,261 are pledged as collateral for the notes, per Bitcoin.com News.

calendar.event: MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR) from its indexes
calendar.note: Takes effect at the close on 30 Nov. MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million MSTR shares, about 3.1% of its shares; JPMorgan estimated about $2.8 billion of selling, per Cointelegraph. Metaplanet and Upexi are also being removed.

calendar.event: ISM manufacturing PMI (Nov), job openings (JOLTS, Oct); Fed's Bowman testifies to the House
calendar.note: ISM: consensus 55.2, October 55.5, per Economic Weekly. JOLTS: September was 7.5 million, per the BLS. Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman testifies at the House Financial Services "Oversight of Prudential Regulators" hearing, per the Fed's calendar. Marvell reports after the close, per StockTitan.

calendar.event: ADP private payrolls (Nov); Salesforce and Snowflake earnings
calendar.note: ADP: consensus 80,000, October 86,000, per Economic Weekly. Salesforce and Snowflake report after the close, per StockTitan.

calendar.event: US jobless claims; ISM services PMI (Nov); Jensen Huang before the Senate
calendar.note: Claims: consensus 193,000, prior 189,000. ISM services at 10:00am: consensus 54.5, October 54.5. Both per Economic Weekly. The Senate Banking Committee holds a public hearing with Nvidia's Jensen Huang on AI-chip export controls at 10:00am ET, per JBizNews.
Consensus +90,000 jobs with unemployment at 4.1%; October was +165,000 and 4.1%, per Economic Weekly. Weekly bitcoin options also expire at 08:00 UTC (03:00am ET) that day, per BasisCharts.

Markets expect a rate hike, not a cut: CME FedWatch showed a 97.5% chance of a quarter-point hike as of 27 Nov, per Beansprout, and 97.8% after the 25 Nov PCE release, per Gate News. The Fed's calendar lists the decision at 2:00pm ET and the press conference at 2:30pm ET.
